# ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry Daily Update (May 18, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw an automated codegen update to `addresses.json` and the opening of a new pull request to update standard proof-game timing parameters. Several issues were discussed, with one being closed due to being outdated.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

*   **Automated Codegen Update**
    *   An automated codegen update was performed, modifying `superchain/extra/addresses/addresses.json` ([#1231](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1231)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
A new pull request, [#1232](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1232), was opened to update standard proof-game timing parameters.

## CLOSED ISSUES

*   **Documentation and Spam Issues**
    *   An issue regarding documenting interop tx pool eviction behavior on reorg was closed, as the behavior is implemented in `op-reth` and not deemed worth documenting ([#19351](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19351)).
    *   A spam issue generated by an AI was closed ([#20847](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20847)).

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were opened today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

*   **Flaky Test: `TestELSyncSafeRetractedByOffset` ([#20334](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20334))**
    *   Discussion continues on the `TestELSyncSafeRetractedByOffset` flake. The latest comment suggests that the `OffsetELSafe = 10s` setting, which holds the verifier's reported safe head back, might be causing the preset's baseline sync gate to become unreachable. This could explain the "failed permanently after 30 attempts" message, as the equality target the gate polls for is inherently unreachable. Further investigation is proposed to log the delta between `sequencer.safe` and `verifier.safe` to confirm if the offset is the blocker.

*   **`OPContractsManagerMigrator`: chain B's `SystemConfig.delayedWETH` not repointed during shared-DGF migration ([#20502](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20502))**
    *   A recent comment suggests this issue might be a duplicate of [#20511](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20511).

*   **Add `superchain-ops` template wrapping `OPContractsManagerMigrator.migrate` ([#20503](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20503))**
    *   A recent comment suggests this issue can be closed as it might be a duplicate of [#19017](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19017).

*   **Migrate remaining dispute game tests from `op-e2e/super_test.go` to `op-acceptance-tests` ([#20814](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20814))**
    *   A new comment suggests an alternative approach: integrating `op-supernode` into `op-e2e` instead of `op-supervisor`, which might be faster than porting all the tests to `op-acceptance-tests`.

*   **Update withdrawal `op-chain-ops` command for U16a ([#17470](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/17470))**
    *   The latest comment indicates that this issue is likely superseded by [#18615](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18615), which removed the `superRootsActive()` branch from the withdrawal command and unified proving through the 4-argument `proveWithdrawalTransaction` path. The current code no longer requires the proposed lockbox pre-check.

*   **`opcm`: Avoid mocking in `test_addGameType_permissionedSuper_succeeds` ([#17928](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/17928))**
    *   A recent comment asks if this issue can be closed as already addressed or outdated, as the real migration behavior for Super games is now exercised in migration tests.
